freeTier.summary: No ongoing free plan. Kajabi offers only a 14-day free trial on every plan (see trial); there is no free-forever tier.

trial.summary: Every plan (Kickstarter, Basic, Growth, Pro) offers a 14-day free trial with no extensions. A card is required at signup: a $149 authorization hold (not a charge) is placed to validate it, and is released once the card is confirmed valid. Canceling before the trial ends avoids any charge; otherwise billing starts automatically at the plan price selected at signup. Most features work during the trial, but bulk contact import, a custom email domain, site-wide email-template editing, and a few automation actions (send certificate/single-use coupon, grant an offer, send an email, register to an event) are locked until the account is on a paid subscription.

plans.name: Kickstarter
plans.note: Not listed on Kajabi's current public pricing pages (kajabi.com/pricing and kajabi.com/pricing-new), which show only Basic, Growth and Pro. Reached only via a direct legacy/lower-tier checkout link that still works as of this record: 14-day free trial then $71/mo billed annually ($852/yr), labelled "Save $216.00/year." A guessed month-to-month checkout URL (v3_kajabi_kickstarter_monthly, by analogy with the other plans' URLs) returned a Cloudflare block page rather than a price, so no monthly figure could be captured. Kajabi's help center still names Kickstarter as one of its "current plans" for admin-user limits, but its contacts/products/websites/communities limits were not found on any page or help article captured.

addOns.name: Extra contacts
addOns.unit: per 5,000 additional contacts per month (billed on the same cadence as the base plan)
addOns.note: Increased from $20 to $25 per 5,000 contacts as of the Jan 13, 2026 price update. The pricing page also markets this same rate in bigger 25,000-contact blocks at $125/month.

addOns.name: Extra admin user
addOns.unit: per additional admin user per month

addOns.name: Extra funnels
addOns.note: Listed as a paid feature-limit increase even though the current plans market funnels as "Unlimited."

addOns.name: AI credits top-up
addOns.unit: per 500 additional AI credits, either as a recurring monthly bundle or a one-time top-up
addOns.note: Unused monthly-bundle credits do not roll over between billing cycles.

addOns.name: Branded Mobile App
addOns.unit: per month, on top of the base plan
addOns.note: Included free on the Pro plan. Also unlocks Community access inside the branded app.

addOns.name: Public API access (legacy Pro plans only)
addOns.note: Only applies to accounts on a legacy Pro subscription without API access already included; the current Pro plan includes API access at no extra charge.

addOns.name: Backstage extra client seat
addOns.unit: per month, per additional Backstage client beyond the first
addOns.note: Backstage (a premium 1:1/small-group coaching product) and its first client seat are bundled into every plan at no extra charge; Kajabi calls Backstage a Beta feature with pricing subject to change.

addOns.name: Expert Agent (AI chat agent for a site)
addOns.unit: per agent per month (standard rate, effective Oct 1, 2026); each agent includes 1,000 messages and 250 AI credits per month
addOns.note: An introductory rate of $49/agent/month (locked for 12 months) applied to agents purchased Aug 1–Sep 30, 2026, with 30% off ($34.30/mo/agent) for a 2nd-plus agent bought in that window; no multi-agent discount at the standard rate. As of this record's capture date, Kajabi's own pricing/comparison pages still list Expert Agents as "Coming soon" on every plan, so current purchasability is unclear despite this published help-center pricing.

extraCosts.label: Kajabi Payments card processing (US-registered accounts)
extraCosts.note: Kajabi's own built-in payment processor; Growth and Pro get discounted rates. Not summed into the scenario totals below because every seller, on any platform, pays some card-processing rate.

extraCosts.label: Third-party payment-processor surcharge (e.g. Stripe, instead of Kajabi Payments)
extraCosts.display: 2% (Basic) / 1% (Growth) / 0.5% (Pro) of each transaction, only in regions where Kajabi Payments is offered
extraCosts.note: Excludes PayPal and any region where Kajabi Payments isn't available; does not apply at all if the seller stays on a legacy (pre-2026) plan.

extraCosts.label: Kajabi Payments international-card surcharge (US accounts)
extraCosts.display: +1.5% when the customer's card was issued outside the US

extraCosts.label: Kajabi Payments recurring-billing fee
extraCosts.display: +0.7% on every payment in a subscription or payment plan, including the first one, on top of the base card rate

extraCosts.label: Kajabi Payments dispute (chargeback) fee
extraCosts.note: Non-refundable even if the dispute is later resolved in the seller's favor.

extraCosts.label: Kajabi Payments Instant Payout fee
extraCosts.display: 1.5% of the payout amount, $0.50 minimum, per on-demand instant payout
extraCosts.note: Optional; Kajabi's regular scheduled payouts carry no fee.

extraCosts.label: Parked (paused) account fee
extraCosts.note: Lets a seller pause instead of cancel; the site goes offline to customers, any legacy plan or discount is forfeited, and reactivating requires subscribing to a current standard plan.

billingNotes: Prices rose across all plans effective the first billing date on or after January 13, 2026; Kajabi calls the pre-increase prices "legacy" pricing. Migrating off a legacy plan is permanent and cannot be reversed.

Every plan can switch between monthly and annual billing, or be upgraded/downgraded, at any time; Kajabi does not offer a price lock or renewal discount, so an annual plan renews at Kajabi's then-current published price.
A 30-day money-back guarantee is stated on the pricing page and repeated at checkout on every signup flow captured.

Kickstarter is not listed on Kajabi's current public pricing pages; it was reached only via a direct legacy checkout link, and Kajabi's help center still names it as one of the four current plan tiers.
A 10% nonprofit discount is available on request with documentation of nonprofit status; it applies to the Kajabi subscription only, not to coupons a seller creates for their own customers.
"Powered by Kajabi" footer branding can be removed on Growth and Pro; transactional emails and the Kajabi mobile app always show Kajabi branding, on every plan.
Subscription tax (sales tax/VAT/GST) is calculated on the billing address and shown as a separate invoice line; it does not change what a seller's own customers pay.
Downgrading to a lower plan is blocked while current usage (contacts, products, etc.) exceeds that plan's limits; usage must be reduced first.

regional.note: Subscription prices ($179/$249/$499 month-to-month; $143/$199/$399 effective-annual) were shown in USD with no country or currency selector visible from a US-locale browser. Kajabi Payments processing fees, by contrast, vary sharply by country: e.g. Australia's domestic card rate is 1.70%/1.60%/1.50% + A$0.30 by plan (Basic/Growth/Pro) versus the US's 2.9%/2.8%/2.7% + $0.30, and Australia's rate is scheduled to drop further on 1 October 2026 and 1 April 2027.

scenarios.label: Solo course creator, $3,000/month in sales
scenarios.assumptions: 1 person with 1 staff account (the owner) selling $3,000/month. The sell-layer grid fixes only sales and staff count, not contacts; following this site's convention for other contact-tiered sell-layer tools, we borrow the run-layer solo figure of about 1,000 contacts. Basic's caps (2,500 contacts, 5 products, 2 total admin users including the owner) comfortably cover this. Billed monthly. Kajabi takes 0% of sales on every plan. Card processing is left out of the total: Basic's Kajabi Payments rate is 2.9% + $0.30 (2.9% × $3,000 = $87 plus 30¢ per order), paid to Kajabi Payments or, at a 2% surcharge, to a third-party processor — every seller pays some card-processing rate.

lines.label: 1 admin user (within Basic's 2-user cap, no per-seat charge)

scenarios.label: Small team, $30,000/month in sales, 3 staff accounts
scenarios.assumptions: 5 people with 3 staff accounts selling $30,000/month, using the borrowed run-layer figure of about 5,000 contacts. Basic is ruled out twice over: its 2-total-admin-user cap (1 owner + 1 additional) is short of the 3 staff accounts needed, and its 2,500-contact cap is half the assumed list. Growth covers both (11 total admin users, 25,000 contacts) with room to spare. Billed monthly. Card processing is left out: Growth's Kajabi Payments rate is 2.8% + $0.30 (2.8% × $30,000 = $840 plus 30¢ per order), or a 1% surcharge on a third-party processor.

lines.label: 3 admin users (within Growth's 11-user cap, no per-seat charge)

scenarios.note: Billed annually, Growth is $199/month ($2,388/year, "Save $600/year"). If the list stays at or under Basic's 2,500 contacts and only 1 extra admin user is needed, Basic at $179/month would work instead.

scenarios.label: Growing team, $150,000/month in sales, 8 staff accounts
scenarios.assumptions: 15 people with 8 staff accounts selling $150,000/month, using the borrowed run-layer figure of about 25,000 contacts. 8 staff accounts alone would still fit Growth's 11-total-admin-user cap, but the assumed contact count exactly equals Growth's 25,000-contact ceiling, leaving no headroom — and Kajabi locks an account out (after a 30-day grace period) once a plan's contact limit is reached. Pro's 100,000-contact cap gives real headroom for a business this size. Billed monthly. Card processing is left out: Pro's Kajabi Payments rate is 2.7% + $0.30 (2.7% × $150,000 = $4,050 plus 30¢ per order), or a 0.5% surcharge on a third-party processor.

lines.label: 8 admin users (within Pro's 26-user cap, no per-seat charge)

scenarios.note: Billed annually, Pro is $399/month ($4,788/year, "Save $1,200/year"). If the actual contact count is well under 25,000, Growth at $249/month (plus contact add-ons at $25/month per extra 5,000, if needed) could still work.

unverified: Kickstarter's month-to-month price and its contacts/products/websites/communities limits are not published on any page captured; only its annual price ($71/mo, $852/yr) was found, on a legacy checkout link not linked from Kajabi's current public pricing pages. A guessed monthly-checkout URL returned a Cloudflare block page rather than a price.

Website Widgets add-on pricing is described only as "multiple paid tier levels" on Kajabi's help center; the actual dollar amounts appear to be shown in an image/table that the headless-browser text capture did not extract.

Expert Agents (AI chat agents) are still marked "Coming soon" on the live pricing and feature-comparison pages for every plan, yet a separate help-center article already publishes live per-agent pricing ($49-79/month); whether a new signup can actually buy an Expert Agent today could not be confirmed from a captured snapshot of the purchase flow itself.
Backstage's long-term pricing is explicitly unconfirmed by Kajabi itself: its help article calls Backstage a Beta feature and states "Future entitlements and pricing are subject to change."

Whether the $179/$249/$499 US list prices change for non-US billing addresses (beyond added tax) was not checked; only Kajabi Payments' processing fees are confirmed to vary by country (e.g. Australia's rates, captured separately).
